question: The chemical equation of water is H₂O, Which of the following MS-Word features can be used to write H₂O?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subscript.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• While writing a chemical formula H₂O,** the number of molecules is denoted in the subscript form.**
 
• **There is a provision in Microsoft Office Word to write the number in the subscript form by using the 'Subscript' option.**

• **Drop cap**

 
 
• ​MS Word provides a special feature known as a drop cap.
 
• **A drop cap is a large capital letter that presents at the beginning of a text block or a paragraph and has the depth of two or more lines of regular text. **
 
• A drop cap is the largest capital letter or a word(according to the user requirement) which is **used as a decorative element at the beginning of a paragraph.**
 
 
 
• **Superscript​**
 
 
• **​Superscript is a character(s) half the height of a standard character and printed higher than the rest of the text.**
 
• **An example of a superscript is 2⁵. **
 
• Superscript can be used for exponents in mathematics.
 
 
 
• **Strikethrough**
 
 
• **​Strikethrough is a font effect that causes text to appear as though it is crossed out. **
 
• Strikethrough is often** used to indicate text that is no longer valid in a document or on a web page.**
